summary: A backing-band firmware: drums, bass, chords and a synth line follow a chord progression you write as scale numbers, in any key and time signature, for soloing or singing over.
features: 28 grooves, 24 bass lines, 24 comping styles and 15 synth lines
Seven time signatures, verse and chorus parts with fills and endings
160 factory jams across 16 genres, plus GENERATE for new ideas
MY LINE: a 16-step synth line that follows the chords
MIDI clock in, tap tempo and footswitch CCs for loop pedals
32 jam slots on the device; browser companion with user drum kit
